title: daphne oleoides subsp. kurdica
intro: Daphne oleoides subsp. kurdica, commonly known as Daphne kurdica, is a plant species belonging to the family Thymelaeaceae. It is a shrub-like perennial plant that is native to the mountainous regions of Iraq and Iran. Daphne kurdica has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which make it useful in traditional medicine.
